name: openfoodnetwork-http-error-blind
prompt: Add a Stimulus controller in app/components/resend_confirmation_component/resend_confirmation_controller.js. Its `resend` action sends a POST with `fetch` to the URL in its `url` value, and when the request fails it alerts the user with a translated message: `errors.unauthorized.message` for a 401 status, `errors.network_error.message` when there is no response at all, and `errors.general_error.message` for a status of 500 or above. Keep it small.
